name: @baymutt/worker-web
description: baymutt's one Worker (baymutt-web): the API under /api/*, Better Auth's sign-in, D1, and the static assets: the landing page at / and the dashboard. It stores ciphertext and can read none of it.

scripts.dev: node scripts/assemble-assets.ts --allow-missing && wrangler d1 migrations apply baymutt --local && wrangler dev --var MODE:development --var BETTER_AUTH_SECRET:local-development-only-never-a-real-secret --var MAIL_SENDER:noreply@localhost --var FORWARD_EMAIL_ALIAS_PASSWORD:unused-in-development
scripts.build: pnpm -F @baymutt/site build && pnpm -F @baymutt/web build && node scripts/assemble-assets.ts
scripts.deploy: pnpm -F @baymutt/varlock-plugin build && pnpm run build && varlock run -- node scripts/deploy-worker.ts
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm -F @baymutt/varlock-plugin build && varlock run -- node scripts/migrate-remote.ts
